notes.title: Demo release date announcement!
notes.content: [p]In just over two weeks on August 26th the demo of Moose Diver will be released! With a few additions compared to the playtest. Here is a preview of the oxygen generator that will be available, it is an item that can be purchased from Barkie McBarkie’s Divin gear n Stuff and it can be placed anywhere you like on the ocean floor. It works just like the oxygen generator in the base, regenerating your oxygen and recharging the sprint motor battery. It also comes opens up a jet stream between itself and the base which can be used for travelling or to send coins.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643881/acd82ef6293acc12e4a7c37e15e5a1788a488c61.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643881/ebd2cf9bb0759bab1ab228e6337d5d1a2b287213.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643881/e845593304175c0eb5d7cdbc83f6a223205cf1e5.png"][/img][/p]
